name: kwapso-design
status: IN PROGRESS. Then restructured again 2026-08-26 — client ruling, verbatim: "i still don't understand the difference between controls / structures. please merge them, and rename to components." controls/ and structures/ are now one flat components/ — 108 after that pass, which also deleted portal-conversation (client ruling: "delete portal conversation"), and 115 today: portal-conversation was restored 2026-08-27 (dc9d671 — the kwapso client portal imports it at ticket-screen.tsx, so the "no functional consumer" count behind the deletion was wrong), and donut, rings, kpi-progress, radar, tree and spreadsheet have since shipped. compositions/ was unchanged by either 2026-08-26 ruling and is 47 in four folders today: 15 templates, 18 screens (page-failure joined), 9 overlays (delete-confirmation joined), 5 states. compositions.note: RESTRUCTURED 2026-08-24. compositions/ is four folders — templates, screens, overlays, states — and the client's sentence for it is "everything currently compositions/xyz is compositions (and then sections inside of it)". compositions/shapes/, compositions/system/ and compositions/portal/ NO LONGER EXIST. scalesNote: Authoring base is 16px; :root renders 15px. Neither app's default is forced — each sets data-scale on <html>. The portal deliberately sits one step above the system app.

breakpoints.note: Tailwind v4 defaults: sm 40rem / md 48rem / lg 64rem / xl 80rem. Components state their behaviour per breakpoint in their own header comment.

extraDependencies.recharts: ^3.10.1 - the Chart collection. On the commission permitted list but was not installed.
extraDependencies.vite: dev only - builds demo/. Not shipped; consuming apps bring their own bundler.

notDelivered.reason: NOT SUPPORTED, by client decision on 2026-08-22. Kwapso kit ruling 10 already put RTL out of scope; the commission asked for rtl:true and the client has now settled it as LTR-only.
notDelivered.note: The 65 primitives are nevertheless written with CSS logical properties throughout, and motion.css carries [dir=rtl] mirrors for the sheet, tab indicator and stepper connector. That was not reverted: reverting 65 files to physical properties would be pure risk for zero gain, and logical properties resolve identically in LTR. If RTL is ever wanted, the components are most of the way there and the missing piece is a Radix DirectionProvider at the app root.

notDelivered.item: Icon artwork — all 93, plus the 3 added
notDelivered.reason: WAS: placeholder art by instruction — a rounded frame with a per-name dot pattern, deliberately not final and visibly not final, with the client supplying the real icons. The NAMES, the React API, the six sizes and the currentColor wiring were final throughout, and none of them moved when the art landed.
notDelivered.resolution: DELIVERED 2026-08-27: the Iconoir pack (MIT, 1,383 glyphs) was vendored over the placeholders — see iconArt. The swap procedure below is the one that was executed, and it remains the procedure for any future re-vendor or bespoke replacement.
notDelivered.swapProcedure: Drop the real <Name>.svg over the placeholder in foundations/icons/, run `node foundations/icons/generate-icons.mjs`. No component and no call site changes. The generator reads each file's own viewBox, so incoming art may be drawn on any grid.

notDelivered.reason: There is no warning colour in the kwapso palette — seven brand colours and none is amber. The kit assigns overdue to Poppy, and ruling 26 states mango is the brand, not a status. Folded into danger by decision, so Badge variant="warning" still renders (poppy). --warning-strong resolves identically to --warning rather than inventing a deeper amber.
notDelivered.recommendation: Leave folded, or open a kit ruling to admit an eighth brand colour.

notDelivered.reason: The kit designs three series colours (sky, forest, poppy) and says they cycle. 4 and 5 are placeholders repeating 1 and 2, so a five-series chart currently shows two indistinguishable pairs.
notDelivered.recommendation: Two dedicated data-safe hues need a kit ruling. Never mango (brand, not data) and never grey (reads as disabled).

foundationsFolder.status: DONE — client ruled D10-B on 2026-08-24 after seeing the full cost drawn; tokens/, icons/ and motion/ now live under foundations/.
foundationsFolder.reason: The agreed structure groups tokens/, icons/ and motion/ under a foundations/ folder, and the folder is now made. The count in the superseded note was low: eighty tracked files reach the three folders by relative path, not thirteen — 14 decision and index pages under verify/, 11 verify harnesses (10 Tailwind entry sheets and one .tsx), 42 kit source files, 7 demo and mini-app files, and 6 documentation files, plus package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, README.md and this manifest naming them without a '../'. Two further references pointed OUT of the moved folders and were missed by that grep entirely: foundations/tokens/tokens.css reached ../assets/fonts/ for its three @font-face rules, and foundations/icons/icon-base.tsx reached ../lib/utils. All were repaired. Every one of the fourteen decision pages was reopened in a browser afterwards and asserted styled — stylesheet count, computed body font-family and computed background — because a missing stylesheet is not an error in HTML and checking that the file exists is not checking that the page has its paper.
foundationsFolder.consumingApps: There is no exports map and no path alias — the kit is vendored source, so every import is a literal path. An app's two stylesheet imports each gain one segment (kwapso-design/foundations/tokens/tokens.css and kwapso-design/foundations/motion/motion.css) and every 'kwapso-design/icons' becomes 'kwapso-design/foundations/icons'. Nothing else moved by D10-B: controls/, structures/ (merged into components/ on 2026-08-26, a separate ruling), compositions/ and lib/ were all untouched by THIS move. The rows are in README.md's import table.
